payload.methodology: Per class, distinct top-N players whose score rose (or who first appear) on its Effort board, counted over the 24 hours up to each capture (the union of every capture window in that span). (Paragon boards are excluded as ambiguous - counts are Effort-only.) The default 'clean' (established) view keeps only players who, snapshot at the window end, clear every configured floor - Power Rank (1000+i board), Effort (4000+i) and XP (board 21005) - filtering new characters and throwaway alts; the 'All' view counts everyone. Effort boards reset weekly (Mon 11:00 UTC); a window crossing the reset is unmeasurable, so the 24 hours after it have no point. 'Share' is share of class activity (a player active on several classes counts in each), not distinct players. Lower bound: players outside a board's top-N aren't seen.
